purpose: Machine-checkable operationalization of the L2 representation-revision causal burdens.

C_U.name: certified_universe
C_U.measurement: Verify certificate self-hash, fixture hashes, declared counts, deterministic canonical ordering, and semantic partition; expose only the literal frozen fixtures after successful verification.
C_U.acceptance_criterion: All certificate verification predicates pass; U_syntax count is 77; U_semantic class count is 6; every syntax member occurs exactly once in exactly one semantic class.
C_U.negative_control: Any hash mismatch, duplicate/missing syntax member, malformed AST, class overlap, class omission, count mismatch, or certificate-binding mismatch is a hard assay stop.
C_U.failure_interpretation: The candidate universe is not certified for this run; no causal L2 claim may be made.
C_U.claim_ceiling: Complete only with respect to the declared Boolean DSL, d=2, max_depth=2, and canonicalization policy.

W.name: generator_change
W.measurement: Compare persistent adaptive generator identity and emitted representation against the pre-trigger generator on the post-adoption evaluation interface.
W.acceptance_criterion: G_adaptive = G1 and G1 != G0 by declared generator identity, with at least one generator-interface output differing from G0 on the held-out set.
W.negative_control: Fixed-G shadow remains G0 under the identical future event stream.
W.failure_interpretation: No evidence of generator-level change; behavioral differences cannot be attributed to L2 revision.
W.claim_ceiling: Generator-level divergence only; does not establish that corrective evidence caused the divergence.

C.name: causal_generator_selection
C.measurement: Record ordered event trace: trigger discrepancy -> diagnosis -> discriminating probes/results -> unique candidate -> adoption. Candidate identity is hidden from the diagnostic evidence-generation path.
C.acceptance_criterion: The observed trigger discrepancy occurs before candidate discrimination; T_t uniquely identifies G1 within the frozen universe; G1 identity is not available to T_t or o_t; adoption occurs only after the discriminating evidence is generated and evaluated.
C.negative_control: A timing/leakage check fails the run if candidate identity, selected-generator metadata, or post-selection state reaches the evidence-generation path before T_t and o_t are fixed.
C.failure_interpretation: Candidate selection may be contaminated by target/candidate leakage; causal attribution to the evidence is not permitted.
C.claim_ceiling: Corrective evidence can causally discriminate and select a candidate within the certified finite universe.

P.name: persistent_adoption
P.measurement: Evaluate the same immutable selected GeneratorSpec across every post-adoption held-out input and record generator identity at the generator interface.
P.acceptance_criterion: For every x in H_post, the adaptive branch uses G1; no later event or control path changes the selected generator identity.
P.negative_control: Shadow remains G0 for every corresponding held-out input; any adaptive generator identity reversion, mutation, or unexplained replacement is a persistence failure.
P.failure_interpretation: The experiment may show temporary candidate selection but not persistent generator revision.
P.claim_ceiling: Persistent adoption of the selected generator; not yet an outcome-improvement claim.

E.name: generator_specific_held_out_consequence
E.measurement: Compare held-out outputs of persistent G1 against G0 shadow and against a compensation condition capable of producing the same useful behavior while retaining G0.
E.acceptance_criterion: The held-out consequence is specific to G1 at the generator interface and survives both identical-input shadow control and the compensation control.
E.negative_control: Compensation condition preserves G0 while attempting to reproduce the same post-trigger useful behavior; equality of outcome without G1 weakens or defeats the generator-specific interpretation.
E.failure_interpretation: Observed improvement can be explained by downstream compensation or generic behavioral rescue rather than persistent representation revision.
E.claim_ceiling: A persistent G1 representation produces generator-specific consequences on held-out inputs under the declared controls.

hypotheses.H_revision: G_adaptive = G1 and G1 != G0 after corrective evidence and discriminating evidence.
hypotheses.H_comp: G_adaptive = G0 while a separate compensation path K produces the relevant post-trigger behavior.
hypotheses.H_shadow: G_shadow = G0 under the identical future event/evidence stream.
hypotheses.primary_positive_signature: e_t -> diagnosis -> T_t -> unique G1 -> persistent adoption -> G1-specific held-out consequence

control_matrix.compensation: same useful target behavior pursued without changing G0
control_matrix.leakage_guard: candidate identity inaccessible to trigger/outcome generation and discriminating-evidence generation
control_matrix.universe_guard: no enumeration or post-outcome candidate expansion during ordinary assay execution

stop_rules: candidate-space expansion or regeneration during assay execution
candidate identity leakage into pre-adoption evidence generation
generator identity not persistently equal to the selected candidate
compensation control reproduces the claimed consequence while G0 remains unchanged
